title: Build Burke's Bus Service - Public Pre-Trip Checklist with Admin Dashboard

requirements.text: Create a public-access pre-trip checklist form for a 28-ft box truck with 7 sections: Documents & Cab (18 items), Engine Compartment (9 items), Tires & Wheels (6 items), Brakes & Suspension (6 items), Lights & Electrical (7 items), Box/Cargo Area (7 items), Safety & Emergency (5 items), Final Walk-Around (5 items), and Driver Acknowledgment (2 items). Each item must be a checkbox with the exact labels provided in the pre-checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: All 7 sections are rendered with section headers and emojis
All 65+ checklist items appear as checkboxes with exact labels from the pre-checklist
Checklist is visually organized and easy to navigate on mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Implement local browser storage to save checklist progress while users are working on it, so they don't lose their progress if they navigate away or refresh the page before submitting.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkbox states persist in browser localStorage while checklist is in progress
Progress is cleared after successful submission
Users can return to an incomplete checklist and see their previous selections

requirements.text: Create a backend endpoint to accept and store completed pre-trip checklist submissions anonymously. Store all checkbox states, submission timestamp, and any driver acknowledgment information.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores checklist submissions with all checkbox states
Each submission includes a timestamp
Submissions are stored without requiring user authentication
Data structure supports querying all submissions for admin view

requirements.text: Add a submit button to the checklist form that sends the completed checklist to the backend for storage. After successful submission, clear the local browser storage and show a confirmation message.
acceptanceCriteria: Submit button is clearly visible at the end of the checklist
Submission sends all checkbox states to the backend
Success confirmation is displayed after submission
Local storage is cleared after successful submission

requirements.text: Create an admin dashboard accessible only through Internet Identity authentication. The dashboard should be accessible to specific principals for Brent Berkemeier and Wendell.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin route is protected by Internet Identity authentication
Only authorized principals (Brent Berkemeier and Wendell) can access the admin dashboard
Unauthorized users are redirected or shown an access denied message

requirements.text: Build an admin view that displays all submitted checklists in a table or list format. Include submission timestamps, completion status summary, and the ability to view full details of each checklist submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can see a list of all checklist submissions
Each submission shows timestamp and basic completion info
Admin can click on a submission to view full checklist details
Submissions are sorted by timestamp (most recent first)

requirements.text: Ensure the entire application (public checklist and admin dashboard) is fully responsive and works seamlessly on mobile devices (iOS and Android) as well as desktop browsers.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist form is easy to use on mobile screens with touch-friendly checkboxes
Admin dashboard is navigable and readable on mobile devices
Layout adapts appropriately to different screen sizes
No horizontal scrolling required on mobile

requirements.text: Design a professional, clean visual theme for Burke's Bus Service that conveys reliability and safety. Use a color palette and typography that reflects the transportation/logistics industry, and apply this theme consistently across both the public checklist and admin dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: A cohesive color scheme is applied throughout the application
Typography choices support readability and professionalism
Visual design reflects transportation/safety industry standards
Theme is consistent across public and admin interfaces

constraints: Use Internet Identity only for admin authentication, not for public checklist access
Public checklist must not require any sign-in or authentication
Checklist items must match exactly the pre-checklist content provided by the user
Admin access must be restricted to specific principals for Brent Berkemeier and Wendell
nonGoals: User accounts or profiles for drivers completing checklists
Integration with external fleet management systems
Offline functionality beyond local browser storage
